drafts.body: Hi — you reported checkout returning a 500 with error PAY-5012 yesterday morning. That was our bug, not yours: it affected checkout confirmations starting Aug 11 and we've identified the likely cause. We'll follow up here the moment it's resolved. Thanks for the console detail — it helped.

Hi — about the ~$2,400 order that kept spinning at the final step: you weren't doing anything wrong. We found a checkout issue affecting larger orders since Aug 11 and are working on it now. Your cart is safe to retry once we confirm the fix — we'll reply here when it ships.

Hi — the blank payment page you reported is part of a checkout issue that began Aug 11, affecting several customers. It's not specific to your account or plan. We're on it and will update you here as soon as it's fixed.
